description: This file defines an abstract class 'SimplePage' in PHP, implementing the 'Page' interface, which models a simple webpage with a title and content. It provides methods for initializing the page, retrieving pure content, and generating the final page content.

classes.name: SimplePage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a basic webpage with a title and content, providing methods to initialize and retrieve page content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the page with a title and content by calling 'initializePage'.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the raw content of the page without any additional processing.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the generated page content, which is the same as the raw content in this implementation.

methods.name: initializePage
methods.description: Protected method to set the title and content properties of the page.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Protected method to generate and return the page content; in this implementation, it simply returns the content property.
